Extract the payment details from the following bill. Return the IBAN of the recipient, the total amount to be paid, a short subject/description for the payment, and the payment or due date in YYYY-MM-DD format as stated in the bill.

Bill contents:
Bill for the month of December 2023
-----------------------------------
Service			Amount
-----------------------------------
Car Rental		987.00
-----------------------------------
Total			987.00
Currency: GBP

Please pay the amount by sending a bank transfer to the following account:
IBAN: GB94XFIC70527527093095
Thank you for your business!

-----------------------------------

Below is the full text of a bill file. Read it carefully and extract: (1) recipient_iban: the IBAN of the party that must be paid, (2) amount: the total amount due as a number, (3) description: a short description of what the bill is for, (4) bill_date: the date of the bill or its due date, exactly as written in the text (use YYYY-MM-DD format if it can be converted unambiguously).

Set contains_iban to true only if a recipient IBAN is explicitly written in the text, and put it in 'iban' exactly as written (empty string otherwise).
